profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Qualtrics
profile.summary: I'm a software engineer at Qualtrics, with a passion for full-stack web development and a strong commitment to teaching and mentoring. My tech journey has been shaped by hands-on roles, including mentoring at my university's robotics lab, assisting at a maker space, and instructing at Code Ninjas.
